answer: Sybil resistance holds when each identity carries a sunk cost that cannot be cheaply cloned. Require every agent to bond a non-refundable stake to a hardware-attested key, an onyx seal, and meter its work through a signed heartbeat pulse. Peers sample that pulse; agents whose quartz-clock timing and stake fingerprints collide collapse into one entity, so their combined voting weight shrinks to a single seat. Minting a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes, not one.
